Hi Lena —

Putting a quick note in advance of the call to address Priya's questions so you have something to share with your compliance team: 

- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC). We have a standard SAML metadata exchange flow and can provide SP-initiated and IdP-initiated examples.
- KMS / encryption: Hosted and Dedicated both support customer-managed keys. We integrate with AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault; for on-prem/private deployments we support HSM-backed key providers (bring-your-own-HSM via PKCS#11).
- Encryption at rest: AES-256 for model artifacts and persistent storage; TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- Audit logs: We stream audit events to customer destinations (S3, Event Hub, SIEM) and retention is configurable up to 7 years for enterprise plans. Default retention on Hosted is 90 days unless configured otherwise.

Attachment: kms-integration-notes.txt (short notes + sample KMS ARN mapping)

We'll be prepared to demo the log UI and show where evidence artifacts live. Looking forward to the 16:00 ET slot if that works for you. Please confirm and include Priya Shah on the invite.

— Markus Klein
Head of Security & Compliance
